clue.text: Suitably nifty clues, if solved

indicators.note: a puzzle once solved has its pieces worked out, so these twelve letters are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Clever clues, once cracked, are said to be fitting enough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'solved' pretends to describe the clues but tells you to rearrange the letters of NIFTY CLUES IF.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe doing something to an adequate degree, enough to suit the purpose.

clue.text: Protection of rank protecting lieutenant

indicators.note: one word protecting another surrounds it, so the officer's abbreviation sits inside the word for rank

parts.note: rank in the sense of utter or downright means sheer

explanation.surface: Military talk: the safeguarding a high rank gives a junior officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rank' looks like a military grade, but here it is the adjective meaning complete, as in rank amateur.
explanation.definitionFit: A refuge or cover is a form of protection from weather or danger.

clue.text: Fine instrument?

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil grades
a lute is a plucked stringed instrument

explanation.surface: A question about whether something is a fine musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the answer, a delicate woodwind, while F plus a stringed instrument builds it.
explanation.definitionFit: This woodwind is an elegant, high-voiced instrument, so it is fairly called a fine one.

clue.text: Simple men trying to grip tool

indicators.note: the run of words grips the answer between them, holding it within their letters

explanation.surface: Unsophisticated men attempt to grasp a tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool is any device or utensil used for a job, the same as this word.

clue.text: Single sweetheart doesn't finish proposal

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, hence single

indicators.note: a word that does not finish loses its final letter

parts.note: dear is a term of endearment for a sweetheart

explanation.surface: A lone lover never completes a marriage proposal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doesn't finish' cuts the last letter from DEAR, leaving DEA.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposal is a suggestion or plan put forward, which is a notion offered for consideration.

clue.text: Egypt, say, employing books in hieroglyphics?

indicators.note: a word employing another takes it on inside itself, so the books go within the country

parts.note: Egypt is an example of a nation
OT is the Old Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: Egypt used books written in hieroglyphs, the clue seems to ask.
explanation.definitionFit: Hieroglyphics are a system of written symbols, an example of a symbolic writing scheme, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Initially language almost turned Italian now

definitions.text: Initially language almost turned Italian now

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A tongue that, it seems, nearly became modern Italian.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening letters spell the answer, and the whole clue describes it: the Roman tongue that developed into today's Italian.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Roman tongue evolved into the Romance languages, of which Italian is the modern descendant.

clue.text: When describing supporter this compiler's harsh

indicators.note: describing in its sense of drawing round, so the first word goes around the second

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
a bra is an undergarment that supports
the setter saying 'I have' gives I'VE

explanation.surface: The setter admits to being rough when talking about a backer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describing' is used in its geometric sense of drawing a line around something, so it signals one piece enclosing another.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rough and grating in manner or texture is harsh.

clue.text: Worshipper of deity father left upset

indicators.note: in a down clue upset turns the letters upside down, reading them from bottom to top

parts.note: a deity is a god
pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A devotee of a god whose father went off unhappy.
explanation.definitionFit: A fawning devoted follower is figuratively a worshipper of their master.

clue.text: English crack team with tense tackle

parts.note: a crack is a wisecrack or quip
a team is a group of men
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: An English elite team, a bit nervy, makes a tackle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tackle' looks like a sporting challenge but is the noun meaning gear, as in fishing tackle.
explanation.definitionFit: Tackle means gear or apparatus, as with fishing gear.

clue.text: Bone seeing top part twisting back

indicators.note: twisting back turns the letters round so they read backwards

parts.note: A1 means first-rate or top, written AI
a bit is a part of something

explanation.surface: A bone noticed when the upper part twists backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 for 'top' is a common crossword trick, the digit standing in for the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: The shinbone of the lower leg is one of the body's bones.

clue.text: Weary embracing sweetheart having rows

indicators.note: one word embracing another holds it within its arms, inside its letters

parts.note: weary means tired
the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter E

explanation.surface: A worn-out partner hugs a lover after quarrelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rows' suggests quarrels, but here means lines or levels, as in tiered seating.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranged in layers or ascending levels, like stadium seating, means having rows.

clue.text: Famous Democrat holding together with flag

indicators.note: the outer pair of words holds the joining word within them

parts.note: star as an adjective means famous, a star player
and means together with
D is the usual US political shorthand for a Democrat

explanation.surface: A well-known Democrat clasping a flag at a rally.
explanation.definitionFit: A banner or ensign carried as an emblem is a flag.

clue.text: Socialist accepts a politician giving better access?

indicators.note: one word accepts others by taking them inside itself

parts.note: red means a socialist or left-winger
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A left-winger welcomes a fellow politician offering easier access.
explanation.definitionFit: Fitted with sloping access ways, a building is easier to get into for wheelchairs, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Short skirts make demands on cloth

parts.note: minis are miniskirts
to try someone is to make demands on them, as in try one's patience

explanation.surface: Short skirts strain the fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cloth' looks like fabric but means the clergy, as in a man of the cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: The cloth is an idiom for the clergy, a body of ministers.

clue.text: Magnificent concert's finale due to include Queen

indicators.note: the finale of a word is its last letter
the word for due is made to include the royal abbreviation inside it

parts.note: owing means due, as a debt
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A splendid concert ends with a performance by the band Queen.
explanation.walkthrough: ER for Queen is a crossword convention, from Elizabeth Regina.
explanation.definitionFit: Lofty and imposing, a feat or figure that is outstanding can be called magnificent.

clue.text: Banish former partner over occupation about sex

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

indicators.note: the job word goes about the other, surrounding it

parts.note: a trade is an occupation
it is slang for sex or sex appeal

explanation.surface: Send away an ex who keeps going on about sex at work.
explanation.definitionFit: To hand over a fugitive to another country is a form of banishment, sending them away.

clue.text: Give line out to show lure

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Pay out some fishing line to show off the bait.
explanation.definitionFit: To coax or entice someone by flattery is to lure them.

clue.text: Persistent criminal's hit facing time

parts.note: con is a convict or criminal, with the 's
to tan is to beat or hit, as in tan someone's hide

explanation.surface: A crook's blow comes just before he serves time.
explanation.definitionFit: Unchanging and continual, something persistent goes on without letting up.

clue.text: Drag carrying exercise mat

indicators.note: the word for drag carries the exercise within it

parts.note: to cart is to drag or haul
PE is physical education, exercise

explanation.surface: Hauling an exercise mat to the gym.
explanation.definitionFit: A rug or floor covering is a kind of mat.

clue.text: Goddess, advanced adult around at that time

indicators.note: the two single letters go around the time word, one at each end

parts.note: A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult
then means at that time

explanation.surface: A goddess, mature and grown up, from long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: She is the Greek deity of wisdom, so a goddess.

clue.text: Plaintiff with account copper's heard regularly

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper, with the 's

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of the word

explanation.surface: A complainant gives an account that a police officer hears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' looks like a policeman but is the metal, Cu.
explanation.definitionFit: A plaintiff brings a charge in court, making them the one who charges another.

clue.text: Dished up again, possibly cold

definitions.meaning: a cold, aloof person is reticent or withdrawn

explanation.surface: Leftovers dished up again, perhaps cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Read with a hyphen it means served once more; read whole it means aloof, and a cold person may be so.

clue.text: Dangerous element from artist fellow

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
a don is a university fellow

explanation.surface: A hazardous substance obtained from an artist chap.
explanation.walkthrough: A don is a fellow, meaning a lecturer at a British university such as Oxford or Cambridge.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a radioactive gas, a chemical element that is a health hazard.

clue.text: Diplomacy in charge of subterfuge

parts.note: tact is diplomacy

explanation.surface: Diplomacy that is in charge of trickery.
explanation.definitionFit: A ploy or ruse used to gain an end is a subterfuge.

clue.text: Someone being virtually insulting?

parts.note: virtually here means online, in the virtual world, where provocateurs post abuse

explanation.surface: A person who is almost rude.
explanation.walkthrough: 'virtually' seems to mean nearly, but means on the internet.
explanation.definitionFit: An internet provocateur deliberately posts offensive messages online to upset others.

clue.text: Makes fun of blokes

definitions.meaning: to mock or ridicule, a verb

explanation.definitionFit: One word is the verb meaning to ridicule and the plural noun for men or chaps.

clue.text: Offended and judged in EastEnders

indicators.note: EastEnders is a soap set in London's East End, where Cockneys drop their H's, so the word is said that way

parts.note: a judge who has heard a case has tried or judged it

explanation.surface: Upset, and assessed on a TV soap.
explanation.walkthrough: EastEnders is a British TV soap set among Cockneys in East London; a dropped H turns the word for judged into the answer's sound.
explanation.definitionFit: To offend can mean to sin or do wrong, as one who has made a mistake.

clue.text: Sticky slug out in wild

indicators.note: wild signals the letters run wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A slimy slug is out in the wild.
explanation.definitionFit: Gluey and viscous, like a slug's trail, means sticky.

clue.text: Trailers lent out between stars

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Film trailers loaned to the stars of the movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Occurring or located in the space among the stars of a galaxy, the word means between stars.
